/.title: Adam Hale Shapiro
blocks:
I am Vice President of Macro Analysis and Economic Geography at the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco. I study applied micro, macroeconomics, and health economics.  My research focuses on inflation, price setting dynamics, and the U.S. healthcare sector.
